slices.focus: Ayaka wins approval for pre-typhoon staff training with a disruption binder, lane diagrams, and a rule assigning one person per shift to own the notice update clock.
slices.summary: Using spring recovery numbers and passenger complaint tallies, Ayaka gets approval to expand weather-resilience work into pre-typhoon training. The package includes a quick-reference disruption binder, simple lane diagrams, and a rule that one person on each shift owns the official notice update clock. She plans a shared scenario exercise for counter and yard staff together to surface hidden assumptions about handoffs.
open_loops: Training rollout may face resistance from staff who see it as extra paperwork
Yard staff may distrust diagrams that look too polished
Shift-ownership rule may fade without consistent enforcement
decisions: Ayaka won approval to expand her weather-resilience work into pre-typhoon staff training with shift ownership, lane diag
